title: business-parity-reviewer return
description: The business-parity-reviewer's return object, in every mode.

oneOf.description: No Must Fix, or the parity phase is disabled. A round file was written in plan-review mode only.

outcome.description: No Must Fix, or the parity phase is disabled.

findings_file.description: Plan-review mode only: the round file's full path.

reason.description: The disabled-phase no-op only: the disabled phase, on one line.

oneOf.description: At least one Must Fix; the findings were written.

findings_file.description: The flat round file in plan-review mode, the index in implemented-solution mode; full path.

must_fix_count.description: The number of Must Fix findings.

oneOf.description: A cited input could not be read; no findings file was written.

outcome.description: A cited input could not be read.

blocker.description: The unreadable path and the refusal, on one line.
